buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED TEXT BASED ATC CLAUSES – SUPPLY OF ELECTRIC SCOOTER 1. Technical Specifications The Electric Scooter to be supplied shall strictly comply with the specifications stipulated in Government O rder G.O.(Rt) No.2589/2024/LSGD dated 31.12.2024, Government of Kerala, Local Self Government Depart ment. The minimum technical requirements are as follows: Sl. No. Specification Minimum Requirement 1 Top Speed (Actual) 80 km/hr or above 2 Minimum Driving Range 100 km per full charge 3 Certified Range 140 km or above

4 Battery Type Lithium Iron 5 Battery Capacity Above 3 kWh 6 Battery Warranty Minimum 8 years or 80,000 km, whichever is earlier 7 Motor Type PMSM 8 Motor Peak Power 4 kW or above 9 Scooter Warranty Minimum 3 years 10 Charger Warranty Minimum 3 years 11 Charging Time Below 6 hours 12 Rear Suspension Mono-Shock 13 Transmission Belt Driven 14 Battery Protection Rating IP67 15 Motor and Controller Protection IP65/IP66 16 Minimum Boot Space 20 Litres 17 Payload Capacity 160 kg or above 18 Front Brake Disc Brake 19 Rear Brake Disc Brake 20 Wheels Alloy Wheels The bidder shall ensure that the offered vehicle meets or exceeds all the above specifications. 2. Accessories and Additional Items The quoted price shall include the following accessories and items, without any additional cost to the Buye r: a) Portable/compatible battery charger. b) Minimum two ISI-certified helmets (for rider and pillion rider). c) Rear-view mirrors. d) Side stand and centre stand, wherever applicable. e) Floor mat. f) Saree guard and footrest, wherever applicable. g) Tool kit and essential vehicle accessories. h) First-aid kit. i) User manual and warranty/service booklet. j) Any other standard accessories supplied by the manufacturer along with the vehicle. All accessories required for the safe and normal operation of the vehicle shall be supplied along with the sc ooter. 3. Registration and Insurance The successful bidder shall be responsible for completing all necessary registration formalities with the co ncerned Motor Vehicles Department/RTO in the name of Koottilangadi Grama Panchayat. The vehicle shall be delivered with valid registration certificate, number plate, comprehensive insurance and all other statut ory documents. 4. Warranty and After-Sales Service a) The minimum warranty requirements specified in the Government Order shall be strictly complied with. b) The bidder shall provide the manufacturer's warranty certificate for the vehicle, battery and charger sep arately. c) The bidder shall ensure the availability of an authorised service centre in Malappuram District or a near by district. d) Free periodic maintenance/service, if provided by the manufacturer, shall be clearly specified in the offe r. e) The bidder shall provide details of the authorised service centre, contact number and service support ar rangements. . 3.
